def solve():
    gross = Q(55000)
    bp = Q(46000)
    fee = bp * Q("0.03") + (gross - bp) * Q("0.019")
    blended = fee / gross
    refunds = Q(2500)
    credit = refunds * blended
    surcharge = refunds * Q("0.0035")
    net_var = fee - credit
    rebate = min(net_var * Q("0.10"), Q(250))
    net = fee - credit + surcharge - rebate
    return {
        "final": net,
        "gross_variable_fee": fee,
        "refund_credit": credit,
        "rebate_applied": rebate,
    }
